import pandas as pd  

import glob  

from docx import Document 

all_files = glob.glob("*.csv") # adjust path if needed df_list = [pd.read_csv(file) for file in all_files] df = pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True) 

df = df.drop_duplicates() df = df.dropna() 

df["total_sale_value"] = df["quantity"] * df["price"] 

revenue_df = ( df.groupby("store_id", as_index=False)["total_sale_value"] .sum() .sort_values(by="total_sale_value", ascending=False) ) 

top5_df = revenue_df.head(5) 

top5_df.to_excel("top5_stores.xlsx", index=False) 

doc = Document() doc.add_heading("Python Code", level=1) doc.add_paragraph(open(file).read()) # OR paste code manually 

doc.add_heading("Final Output (Top 5 Stores by Revenue)", level=1) doc.add_paragraph(top5_df.to_csv(index=False)) 

doc.save("Sales_Report.docx")
